 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Krishna Prasad Singh, Sr. Advocate
 Mr.Rakesh Singh, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Dilip Kumar No. 1, App
 =====================================================

=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 22-12-2025 Heard learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 46/2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 506 of I.P.C. and Section 4 of P.O.C.S.O. Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, petitioner is alleged to have committed rape of 16 year old girl.
4. Learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has falsely been implicated in the case.
Learned Senior Counsel further submits that he has no criminal antecedent and he is in custody since 15.04.2025.

The petitioner Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.81689 of 2025(2)
dt.22-12-2025 undertakes to co-operate in the case/ trial.

sentences.text: 1 5. Learned APP for the State has opposed the prayer for regular bail of the petitioner on the ground that there is direct allegation against him that he committed rape of a 16 year old girl.
6. Considering the serious allegation levelled against the petitioner, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) tusharika/-
